cohort: The study included 200 pregnant women at or beyond 40 weeks gestational age who were willing to participate.
finding: The study found that oligohydramnios and meconium stained liquor are related to post-dated pregnancy, and a poor Bishop score is associated with a lesser chance of vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: 55% of women had a vaginal delivery, 40% had LSCS, and 5% had an instrumental delivery; a poor Bishop score was associated with a lower chance of vaginal delivery and a higher likelihood of LSCS.
